economy.summary: His campaign site says he supports infrastructure investment and business assistance in former industrial communities, supports Main Street small-business programs, and introduced an Angel Investment Tax Credit for startups.
economy.short: Supports business assistance programs; introduced Angel Investment Tax Credit.

taxes.summary: His campaign site says he introduced legislation for senior property tax freezes and uniform property assessments, and that he has secured funding and tax credits for affordable rental housing.
taxes.short: Introduced senior property tax freeze and uniform assessment legislation.

abortion.summary: Voted against 2022 proposed constitutional amendments stating the Pennsylvania Constitution confers no right to abortion, and against earlier bills restricting specific abortion procedures; has sponsored bills to shield reproductive healthcare providers and patients from out-of-state legal action.
abortion.short: Voted against abortion restrictions; sponsored reproductive-care shield bills.

education.summary: His campaign site says he authored legislation requiring carbon monoxide detectors and lead testing in schools, champions the Ready to Succeed scholarship program, and advocates for early education and protections for homeless students.
education.short: Authored school safety laws; champions Ready to Succeed scholarships.

healthcare.summary: Co-sponsored a 2021 Senate Democratic package to codify federal health insurance protections in state law, sponsoring the bill to prohibit annual and lifetime coverage limits; said no one should have to worry about exceeding arbitrary caps on health insurance coverage.
healthcare.short: Sponsored bill prohibiting annual and lifetime insurance coverage limits.

energy.summary: In a 2026 voter guide response, said he supports the governor's proposals for purposeful and thoughtful data center permitting but opposes state-level preemption of municipal planning efforts.
energy.short: Supports thoughtful data-center permitting; opposes preempting municipal planning.

guns.summary: His campaign site says he is a member of the legislature's SAFE Caucus and introduced Extreme Risk Protection Order (red flag) legislation.
guns.short: Introduced Extreme Risk Protection Order (red flag) legislation.
